column1: # ui widget batch (Button / ScrollPane / ListBox / Glyph / Container / Image)
# Button: fields are (ButtonState, ButtonStyle, label Widget); the style accessor pair -> getStyle/
#   setStyle, the child widget -> setLabel, b() tests "state != DISABLED" -> isEnabled and its
#   setter switches between NORMAL and DISABLED -> setEnabled.
# ScrollPane: a()/a(Widget) are the scrolled content -> getContent/setContent ; b() returns the
#   style's scrollbar width -> getScrollBarWidth ; d() computes the scrollbar length from the
#   content height ratio -> getScrollBarHeight ; the private a(float) clamps and applies the
# ListBox: a = selected index (validated against the item array) -> getSelectedIndex/setSelectedIndex ;
#   b(int) forwards to the label's max width -> setLabelMaxWidth ; d(int) forwards to the label's
#   align -> setLabelAlign ; b() is the combined width of the two arrow buttons -> getArrowWidth ;
#   d() is the item array -> getItems ; a(String[]) installs it and selects the first entry ->
#   setItems. The two static synthetic accessors exist for ListBoxListener: read the selection ->
#   getSelectedIndex(ListBox), set the "selection changed" flag -> setChanged(ListBox,boolean).
# Glyph: per-codepoint glyph storage (k = byte[128][] paged by codePoint >>> 9, one page of 512
#   bytes each); a(char) reads one byte -> getData and a(int,int) writes it -> setData.
# Container: a child list; a(Widget)/b(Widget)/e() -> addChild/removeChild/clearChildren.
# Image: the single TextureRegion accessor pair -> getRegion/setRegion.
